## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her deceitful nature and a habitual tendency to arrive late, which some attribute to a desire for dramatic effect. She exhibits deep jealousy toward Julia, taking clear satisfaction in hearing others criticize her and frequently speaking ill of her behind her back.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

Gertie Pye was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their school days in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She attended local events alongside the other neighborhood youth, including the successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert where the school children performed. Later, she remained involved in the local social circle by participating in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) alongside her peers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane.md)

Gertie and Jane serve together as fellow committee members for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), working collaboratively on local initiatives such as canvassing the [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) road. Their shared involvement in community efforts places them in the same social circle of young people working to better [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Through their joint efforts on the committee, they share the frustrations and challenges of trying to persuade reluctant neighbors to support their cause.

- Comrade of — fellow committee members canvassing the Carmody road (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)</sub>
